bios.short_bio: Mira Sol is an independent producer based in Montreal who builds tracks from field recordings and hardware synths.
bios.long_bio: Mira Sol is an independent producer based in Montreal. Their music is built from field recordings and hardware synths, with influences including Four Tet and early Bonobo.
bios.track_description: “Glass Tides” is a deep house / downtempo track with a warm, nocturnal, reflective mood. It is scheduled for release on 2026-11-07. https://soundcloud.com/example/glass-tides

pitches.subject: Submission: Mira Sol — “Glass Tides”
pitches.body:
Hi Afterhours Radio,

I’m Mira Sol, an independent producer based in Montreal. “Glass Tides” is warm, nocturnal deep house/downtempo built from field recordings and hardware synths. It feels like a fit for your late-night, warm sound. SoundCloud: https://soundcloud.com/example/glass-tides

If you need a private link, please let me know.

Best,
Mira

pitches.subject: Mira Sol — “Glass Tides” (November 7, 2026)
pitches.body:
Hi Blue Hour Club — sharing “Glass Tides,” a warm, nocturnal deep house/downtempo track for a night-drive mood. It’s due out November 7, 2026. SoundCloud: https://soundcloud.com/example/glass-tides

Please let me know if you need the link shared privately.

— Mira Sol
